correctness.rationale: For λ>0 the Gaussian posterior on the unobserved coordinates has inverse principal precision. A gap of g edges gives a Dirichlet path on g−1 vertices (g=1 contributes an empty determinant-one block). The determinant recurrence gives sinh(gθ)/sinh θ, differentiation in λ gives the displayed Fθ, and the smallest path eigenvalue yields the stated increasing function of the longest gap. Up to reflection, the gaps are (t,t,3d−2t). Both d±1 are coprime to 3d since 3 divides d, whereas d is excluded. For h=Fθ or −log sinh(θ·), strict convexity makes 2h(t)+h(3d−2t) decrease up to d and increase thereafter. For the trace, the third derivative of x coth x has sign opposite to H(2x), where H(y)=y(cosh y+2)−3 sinh y and H and its first two derivatives vanish at 0 with H'''(y)=y sinh y>0. The negative log-sinh third derivative is also strictly negative. Hence the centered second difference strictly decreases; subtracting the two nearest primitive costs gives Δ²h(d+1)−Δ²h(d−1)<0. The maximum gaps are d+2 and d+1 respectively and any other primitive t has maximum at least d+2. The reflected optimal sets are distinct: a distinct step representing the same set would have to exchange its two nonzero sites with their doubles, forcing 3s=0. Jensen and the maximum-gap bound independently settle unrestricted optima, uniquely up to rotation. At fixed d, Fθ(g) has constant term (g²−1)/6 and θ² coefficient −(g⁴−1)/90−(g²−1)/36. The left and right candidates have equal squared-gap sums and fourth-power sums differing by 48d, giving −8dλ/15+O_d(λ²); the left-versus-balanced squared-gap excess is 6, giving the unit limiting premium. The λ=0 prior is not invoked. The n=9 exact rational example agrees with the path determinants 3,21,55 for block sizes 1,3,4 at λ=1. The checker was inspected, not rerun; it is supplementary, and the observable coordinate shift orbit concerns nominal observability, not forced-state reconstruction.

evidence: The pinned-cycle finding treats arbitrary k-site pin sets, gives the inverse-trace path formula and optimizes heat traces and positive inverse moments at balanced gaps. The grounded-cycle finding likewise gives block formulas and free optimal leader spacing.
Giribet–Feldberg obtain augmented residual forcing measurements, with recoverability depending on sampling geometry and the forcing prior.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The free-pin minimum is already covered, but that design is excluded. Even a general Schur-convexity result does not compare the two restricted candidates: the largest gap is larger on the left, but the sum of the largest two gaps is larger on the right. The dynamical-sampling framework does not provide a constrained optimum.

evidence: The same inverse-trace cost is prior indexed coverage; its unrestricted optimality result alone cannot determine which of the two incomparable gap triples has smaller cost.

Krause–Singh–Guestrin address mutual information and approximate placement; the cited OU design results prove equispacing in a different admissible class. The cyclic GMRF article was accessible only at abstract/landing-page level in this check.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The new implication uses coprimality and a strict decreasing-curvature comparison across the two candidates, with a different winner from the longest-gap comparison. Neither formula overlap nor abstract-level cycle-covariance context supplies that implication.

evidence: The three-point Sobolev item optimizes an evaluation norm on a mean-zero continuous H¹ circle with three unrestricted sites, not the inverse conditional precision of unobserved lattice sites.

value.rationale: A generator step is the natural exact condition for a single coordinate to traverse the entire nominal shift orbit. It forbids the free optimum and makes optimizing average or volume uncertainty incompatible with optimizing the worst direction, for every positive mass in an infinite family. The sharp optimizer and loss formulas are usable exact design information, not another statement of equispacing.
